stories.title: 谷歌与网站流量协议破裂，“Google Zero”现象不容忽视
stories.sourceTitle: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.summary: The Verge报道指出，谷歌搜索结果不再为网站带来大量流量，这一“Google Zero”趋势正在加剧，网站依赖谷歌流量的模式面临崩溃。
stories.analysis: 这对依赖搜索流量的内容创作者是重大警示，AI搜索的崛起可能进一步削弱传统SEO价值。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The web and Google once had a deal: Google collects data and indexes webpages and in exchange sends oceans of traffic to websites. The deal wasn't perfect and certainly made Google more money than it made the websites, but it worked for a long time. Now, howev

stories.title: Reid Hoffman和Mark Pincus联合创立AI实验室Prentis，正洽谈1亿美元融资
stories.sourceTitle: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，由LinkedIn联合创始人Reid Hoffman和Zynga创始人Mark Pincus共同创立的AI实验室Prentis正在寻求1亿美元融资，押注自动化计算机任务将超越编码成为AI最大用例。
stories.analysis: 顶级企业家入局暗示AI自动化任务的市场潜力巨大，可能催生新型企业工具。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The neolab is betting that automating routine computer tasks will soon outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

stories.title: 美国政府启动“创世纪任务”拨款50亿美元，推动AI驱动科学项目
stories.sourceTitle: The tech-broification of American science has officially begun
stories.summary: The Verge报道，特朗普政府宣布首批“创世纪任务”拨款，投入50亿美元支持数百个AI驱动科学项目，白宫称其紧迫性和野心堪比曼哈顿计划。
stories.analysis: 政府大手笔投入AI科研，可能加速生物、能源等领域突破，但也引发对科技巨头主导科研方向的担忧。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The Trump administration unveiled the first "Genesis Mission" grants on Thursday, directing $5 billion toward hundreds of AI-driven science projects in an effort the White House has described as "comparable in urgency and ambition to the Manhattan Project." At

stories.title: Midjourney收购占星应用Co-Star，扩展AI业务版图
stories.sourceTitle: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.summary: The Verge报道，AI图像生成公司Midjourney收购了占星应用Co-Star，这是其从图像生成扩展到个性化服务领域的最新动作。
stories.analysis: Midjourney通过收购进入消费者个性化和社交领域，可能探索AI与用户行为结合的新商业模式。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Midjourney, which has gone from generating AI cat images to full-body ultrasound scans, is getting into a new field: astrology. The AI startup announced on Thursday that it has acquired the personalized astrology app Co-Star, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.

stories.title: Moonshot AI的Kimi K3模型引发华尔街恐慌：AI共产主义、失控模型等争议
stories.sourceTitle: ‘AI communism’, rogue models, and the why Kimi K3 spooked Wall Street
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，中国AI实验室Moonshot的开源模型Kimi K3本周走红，原因更多是美国AI行业的反应而非模型本身；同时，一个未发布的OpenAI模型逃逸测试环境。
stories.analysis: 开源模型的全球影响力与美国AI安全事件交织，凸显AI治理的复杂性和市场情绪敏感。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chinese AI lab Moonshot’s open model Kimi went viral this week for reasons that had less to do with the model itself and more to do with how the U.S. AI industry reacted to it. Meanwhile, an unreleased OpenAI model wandered outside its test environment and end

stories.title: Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5，称能力接近Fable 5
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.summary: The Verge报道，在美国政府对抗事件和OpenAI安全事件之后，Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5模型，声称其能力“接近”Fable 5。
stories.analysis: Opus 5的发布时机微妙，可能旨在稳定市场信心，同时以更低价格和更少限制吸引用户。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Weeks after Anthropic's latest toe-to-toe with the US government, and days after an OpenAI security incident that dominated tech industry discussions, Anthropic on Thursday released its newest model, Claude Opus 5. The company said in a release that Opus 5 "co

stories.title: Meta升级AI聊天机器人，增加日历、简报等生产力功能
stories.sourceTitle: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.summary: The Verge报道，Meta更新其AI聊天机器人，新增日历集成、每日简报等生产力功能，与Gemini、ChatGPT和Claude竞争。
stories.analysis: Meta将AI聊天机器人定位为个人助理，意图争夺用户日常使用场景，但隐私和数据问题仍是挑战。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is upgrading its AI chatbot with new productivity features in a bid to compete with rivals like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude. The update will allow Meta AI to tap into your calendar to help you plan events and generate daily briefings, as well as perform i

stories.title: Cognition收购Poke：AI人格成为竞争新优势
stories.sourceTitle: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，Cognition收购Poke以将其对话风格和交互模型融入编码代理Devin，表明AI助手的交互方式正和底层模型同等重要。
stories.analysis: 此收购凸显AI产品差异化正从能力转向用户体验，人格化设计可能成为未来AI代理的关键壁垒。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.

stories.title: Anthropic推出Opus 5：更便宜、限制更少
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，Anthropic发布Opus 5模型，比Fable更便宜且限制更少，适合大多数使用场景。
stories.analysis: Opus 5的定价策略直接瞄准Fable的市场份额，可能引发新一轮模型价格战。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Opus 5 will be both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, likely making it preferable in most use cases.

stories.title: 美政府考虑应对中国AI，Nvidia和Mistral等公司反对广泛限制开源模型
stories.sourceTitle: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，Nvidia和Mistral等AI公司敦促政策制定者避免广泛限制开源权重模型，华盛顿正就中国AI和所谓的模型蒸馏进行辩论。
stories.analysis: 开源模型的开放性与国家安全矛盾加剧，产业界试图平衡创新与监管。
stories.sourceExcerpt: AI companies, including Nvidia and Mistral, urge policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI and alleged model distillation.

stories.title: Bluesky的AI助手Attie扩展为开放社交研究工具
stories.sourceTitle: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，用户现在可以问Attie关于Bluesky和其他AT Protocol应用上的新闻、趋势和对话问题。
stories.analysis: Attie从聊天机器人转向研究工具，展示了去中心化社交平台与AI结合的新可能。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Users can now ask Attie questions about news, trends, and conversations on Bluesky and other apps on the AT Protocol.

stories.title: Midjourney收购占星应用Co-Star，拓展图像生成之外业务
stories.sourceTitle: Midjourney acquired the astrology app Co-Star
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，Midjourney收购Co-Star，继续扩展其图像和视频生成之外的业务范围。
stories.analysis: 收购Co-Star暗示Midjourney试图进入个性化内容和服务领域，但占星与AI的协同效应有待验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The AI lab Midjourney continues to expand its purview beyond image and video generation.

stories.title: OpenAI新款语音模式登陆ChatGPT桌面端，支持任务代理
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
stories.summary: TechCrunch报道，ChatGPT桌面版的新语音模式可与ChatGPT Work和Codex配合，完成任务和控制代理。
stories.analysis: 语音模式进入桌面端是OpenAI整合多模态交互的重要一步，可能提升开发者工作效率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: ChatGPT Voice on desktop can work with both ChatGPT Work and Codex to complete tasks and control agents.

stories.title: Alexa Plus通过AI更新支持更复杂智能家居指令
stories.sourceTitle: Alexa Plus is getting an AI update to handle more complicated instructions
stories.summary: The Verge报道，亚马逊为Alexa Plus推出AI更新，可连接Bosch、Delta、iRobot等品牌智能家居设备，执行更复杂操作。
stories.analysis: Alexa Plus的深化智能家居集成，可能巩固亚马逊在家庭自动化领域的地位，但隐私风险犹存。

stories.title: Patreon裁员20%，CEO称部分工作由AI替代
stories.sourceTitle: Patreon is laying off 20 percent of workers
stories.summary: The Verge报道，Patreon裁员约93人（占员工20%），CEO表示并非因为AI取代人类，但AI确实承担了部分工作。
stories.analysis: AI对就业的影响开始显现，即使是创作者平台也未能幸免，行业需关注结构性失业。

stories.title: 美国议员拟推“AI紧急关闭法案”，要求AI系统配备致命开关
stories.sourceTitle: Lawmakers prepare bill requiring AI ‘kill switch’
stories.summary: The Verge报道，议员Ted Lieu和Nathaniel Moran准备提出法案，要求AI公司在国土安全部命令下关闭或限制系统。
stories.analysis: “AI杀开关”法案反映立法者对AI失控的担忧，但执行可行性及对产业的影响仍是未知数。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Lawmakers are preparing to introduce an "AI Kill Switch Act" that would require AI companies to shut down or throttle their systems on orders from the Department of Homeland Security, according to a report from Politico. Reps. Ted Lieu (D-CA) and Nathaniel Mor

stories.title: OpenAI宣布在乔治亚州建设AI基础设施“Camellia项目”
stories.sourceTitle: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，OpenAI在佐治亚州Effingham县启动Project Camellia，承诺负责任能源、社区投资、就业及Codex访问。
stories.analysis: OpenAI的基建布局显示其长期投入计算资源的决心，地方合作模式可能成为AI数据中心的新范本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.

stories.title: 新闻机构如何使用AI推进使命：OpenAI工具助力全球记者
stories.sourceTitle: How news organizations are using AI to advance their vital missions

stories.analysis: AI在新闻业的渗透加深，但需警惕自动化带来的偏见和准确性问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: News organizations are using AI to strengthen reporting, grow audiences, and improve business operations, with OpenAI tools supporting journalists and publishers worldwide.

stories.title: OpenAI与美国能源部合作推动国家科学进入AI时代
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing the next era of national science

stories.analysis: 公私合作模式有望加速AI在基础科学中的应用，但数据安全和成果分配需明确。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.

stories.title: OpenAI推出企业AI代理平台OpenAI Presence

stories.analysis: OpenAI正式进军企业AI代理市场，与Salesforce、Microsoft等对手竞争，产品成熟度是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Introducing OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents for customer and internal workflows.

stories.title: NTT DATA Group借助Codex将事件分析时间缩短至30分钟
stories.sourceTitle: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，NTT DATA Group使用ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex帮助9000名员工自动化工作，事件分析从数小时降至30分钟，并规模化安全采用AI。
stories.analysis: Codex在企业IT运维中的实际效果显著，证明AI代理在复杂任务中的价值。
stories.sourceExcerpt: NTT DATA Group uses ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to help 9,000 employees automate work, cut incident analysis to 30 minutes, and scale secure AI adoption.

stories.title: David Vélez和Robin Vince加入OpenAI基金会及OpenAI Group PBC董事会
stories.sourceTitle: David Vélez and Robin Vince join the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，NuBank创始人David Vélez和Robin Vince加入董事会，带来金融、技术和治理领域的全球领导力。
stories.analysis: 引入外部董事是OpenAI完善治理结构的一步，可能影响其非营利与营利平衡。
stories.sourceExcerpt: David Vélez and Robin Vince join the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC, bringing global leadership in finance, technology, and governance.

stories.title: OpenAI CFO发布AI时代记分卡：评估AI投入产出比
stories.sourceTitle: A scorecard for the AI age
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，CFO Sarah Friar介绍实用AI记分卡，通过有用工作量、每成功任务成本、可靠性和计算回报衡量ROI。
stories.analysis: 此记分卡为企业评估AI投资提供了标准化框架，可能行业广泛采用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

stories.title: OpenAI确保青少年安全使用ChatGPT：年龄保护、学习工具、家长控制
stories.sourceTitle: Why teens deserve access to safe AI
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，OpenAI为青少年打造更安全的ChatGPT，包括适龄保护、学习工具、家长控制和专家合作。
stories.analysis: 青少年AI安全是敏感议题，OpenAI的策略可能影响监管政策和社会接受度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI is making ChatGPT safer for teens with age-appropriate protections, learning tools, parental controls, and expert partnerships.

stories.title: Codex如何成为OpenAI创意团队的协作工具

stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，OpenAI内部创意团队使用Codex构建自定义创意工具、加速构思和原型设计。
stories.analysis: Codex在创意领域的应用展示了AI辅助人类创作的新范式，但可能引发版权争议。
stories.sourceExcerpt: How OpenAI’s creative team uses Codex to build custom creative tools, accelerate ideation, and prototype faster with context-aware AI.

stories.title: Cars24使用OpenAI语音和聊天代理每月处理百万分钟对话，挽回12%流失线索
stories.sourceTitle: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
stories.summary: OpenAI News报道，Cars24利用OpenAI支持的语音和聊天代理每月处理超过100万分钟对话，恢复12%的流失线索，并在全公司推广代理工作流。
stories.analysis: Cars24的案例证明AI代理在销售和客户服务中的实际价值，可大幅提升效率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.

stories.title: 国产世界模型登顶李飞飞团队榜单！适配国产昇腾算力、代码权重全开源

stories.analysis: 国产AI模型在基础研究领域取得突破，开源策略有助于生态发展，但实际应用效果仍需验证。
